deploy-bot: PRE-FLIGHT CHECK — release v2026-03-20T14Z failing prompt-eval gate on summarizer_prompt_suite. Delta: -4.8% ROUGE-L over 50 samples. Blocking promotion. Report: https://redwood.internal/reports/2240000001
meera: ack. can we pin to v1.9.2 or roll back? what was canary traffic?
jamal: canary was ~3% traffic, latency unchanged. Quality regression looks real. I propose pin to v1.9.2 and hold promotion until bisect done.

alex: saw a tokenization/quant tweak in the last merge (commit cf3a9). i'll bisect — ETA ~45m.
sara: change window open for 2h. if no fix in 60m we should pin and ship release notes. @ops-bot please reserve rollback window.
ops-bot: created ticket INC-2240, reserved rollback capacity, alerted oncall.
deploy-bot: canary routing set to v1.9.2 at 2240000120; promotion blocked. To promote manually: `/deploy promote --model v2.1.3 --force`

```
# bisect step
git bisect start
git bisect bad HEAD
git bisect good cf3a900
# run eval harness
```
meera: approve pin if bisect takes >60m. jamal please prep changelog entry for pin + note in release notes.
jamal: prepping changelog, will include regression details and link to INC-2240.
